title: Legislative districts of Davao Occidental

{{Short description | "Political divisions of Davao Occidental in Congress"}} {{Politics of the Philippines}} The '''legislative districts of Davao Occidental''' are the representations of the [[Provinces of the Philippines|province]] of [[Davao Occidental]] in the [[Congress of the Philippines]]. The province is currently represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|lower house]] of the Congress through its [[#Lone District|lone congressional district]]. == History == {{further|Legislative district of Mindanao and Sulu|Legislative district of Davao|Legislative district of Davao del Sur}} Prior to gaining separate representation, areas now under the jurisdiction of Davao Occidental were represented under the [[Department of Mindanao and Sulu]] (1917–1935), [[Davao (province)|Davao Province]] (1935–1967), [[Interim Batasang Pambansa#Regional Representatives|Region XI]] (1978–1984) and [[Davao del Sur]] (1967–1972; 1984–2016). The passage of Republic Act No. 10360{{cite web|title=Republic Act No. 10360 - An Act Creating the Province of Davao Occidental|url=http://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2013/01/14/republic-act-no-10360/|website=Official Gazette of the Republic of the Philippines|author=Congress of the Philippines|accessdate=November 19, 2017|location=Metro Manila, Philippines|date=January 14, 2013}} and its subsequent [[2013 Davao Occidental creation plebiscite|ratification by plebiscite]] on October 28, 2013 separated from Davao del Sur's [[Legislative district of Davao del Sur#2nd District (defunct)|second district]] five municipalities to create the province of [[Davao Occidental]]. Per Section 7 of R.A. 10360, the new province was to comprise [[#Lone District|a single congressional district]]; voters began to elect the new province's separate representative beginning in [[2016 Philippine House of Representatives elections|2016]]. == Lone District == *'''Population (2015)''': 316,342{{cite web|url=https://psa.gov.ph/sites/default/files/attachments/hsd/pressrelease/2015_Table%201_Legislative%20Districts.xlsx|website=Philippine Statistics Authority|date=2015|title=Population of Population of Legislative Districts by Region, Province, and Selected Highly Urbanized/Component City: 2015|accessdate=November 19, 2017}} {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center; width:40%;" |- ! width="40%"| Period !
